title: Clarify current review checkpoint and published release
body:
CONTRIBUTING still directs reviewers of the current result to the historical ternary guide and calls make ternary-note the current-result build target. Point it to the round-two review, selected certificate, and reproduction guide, and label the ternary instructions historical.

Also distinguish the reviewed main checkpoint from the published PR #39 release in docs/reproducibility.md. This matches the README and the pinned release record.

Checked the linked local paths and git diff --check. The independent audit_pair_candidate.py --check docs/research/community-pair-arithmetic.json also passed. No mathematical witness or certificate changes are included, so the full producer suite was not rerun.

Prepared with AI assistance in OpenCode.
